**Verification:** Production testing is done. Smoke tested the Email is Bounced in Saleshandy (Pipedrive) trigger on Production with a short manual pass, 3 checks:

| # | Activity | What was checked | Status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Create a Lead, Create a Deal and Create a Person in Pipedrive | New prospect, step 1 email marked as bounced. One person with one lead and one deal titled with the prospect email, and one activity. | Pass |
| 2 | Delete Person in Pipedrive | Existing person, step 1 email marked as bounced. The person is deleted. | Pass |
| 3 | Create a Person in Pipedrive (real bounce) | Real-bounce address, Send now on step 1. The Emails tab shows Bounced, with one person and one activity (type email, done, subject "Email is bounced in Saleshandy"). | Pass |

**Note:** This was a short manual pass, so the other activities (Update a Person, Update a Deal, Delete Deal, and the Organization activities) are not covered by this verification. Known issues B1 and B2 (Update a Person, Update a Deal and Delete Deal with no person end in Error) are still open and not checked.
waitingFor: QA to check the wording and send. Source: manual production smoke by QA, 2026-10-28, account emailopenedprod, Pipedrive saleshandy.pipedrive.com. All 3 checks passed.
